name: CORZ AI HPC Power Infrastructure Valuation
rationale: Core Scientific, Inc. (CORZ) holds ~1.2 GW of contracted power infrastructure with sub-$0.04/kWh PPAs across prime data center locations. Multi-billion dollar CoreWeave anchor contracts confirm rapid conversion to high-margin AI HPC hosting. At $15.68, 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $28.73 (+83.2% upside at 8.09% WACC). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in a 36.6% CAGR, well below our 48.0% base case. Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 68.0 shares, 3.77% target weight). Accumulate on dips near $15.35, trim Tier 1 at $28.73.

bear.rationale: Execution friction in conversion of remaining power capacity; AI colocation price compression limits margin to 10% on $973M Y5 revenue.
risks: Utility interconnect timeline delays pushing out energization schedules
Bitcoin price weakness compressing legacy mining cash flows during transition

base.rationale: High-density CoreWeave & hyperscaler AI hosting contracts scale to $2.26B Y5 revenue; 22% net margin reflects locked sub-$0.04/kWh power advantage.
risks: Customer concentration across early anchor AI tenants
Capex financing needs for high-density cooling retrofits

bull.rationale: Full 1.2+ GW portfolio successfully converted to tier-3 AI data centers; sovereign and frontier lab demand drives $4.25B revenue at 30% net margin.
risks: Regulatory review of large-scale data center power consumption in regional grids
Emergence of next-gen sovereign nuclear co-located AI campuses
